name: @solidjs-components/platform
description: What every demo database needs besides its own app: Formbird platform documents (core/), accounts, the configuration document, building blocks for templates (form-parts), rulesets (rules) and demo records (seed-kit), the seed (Mongo + Elasticsearch + Redis), fieldtec-web's server config and start, and the one-command setup the app repos' setup-db.mjs runs.
